Hi! I'm Robert Hawkins, an Assistant Professor of Linguistics at Stanford. I've been dabbling with Lean for a while and working on a Lean library for formal linguistics. I'm preparing to open a PR to upstream something to mathlib for the first time (adding the cocommutative coalgebra/bialgebra structure on SymmetricAlgebra) and wondered whether I could get any pre-review pointers from anyone with Bialgebra / RingTheory expertise before I open it?

https://github.com/hawkrobe/mathlib4/commit/9de04a4c9af6fbc9ae69c77dfe08e2da3d7861d5

Hi, and welcome! It is actually easier if you open a normal PR because, for technical reasons, this allow continuous integration to run on whatever modification you're suggesting. You can mark it "WIP" if you prefer that we're aware that it is not yet in polished form (but this is really not important).
awesome, thank you! i will do so.
Once you'll have a PR, you can write here again with the syntax #+<the PR number> (like #39473) so that Zulip will automatically generate a clickable url.

I could use some architectural advice on this PR, and I apologize for not communicating very well in the GitHub thread. I tried to go back and revise my question (pasted below). It seemed like we want a 'single source of truth' for the Coalgebra instance, and using Bialgebra.ofAlgHom constructs a second instance that unfolds differently which feels like it would create problems down the line.

Thanks for the encouragement to push harder on this! I realized Bialgebra.ofAlgHom actually works without needing to revert anything. (When I switched to using congr(...).toLinearMap it got around an earlier problem I was running into with a clunkier approach and I never went back to test it again, so I apologize about for the misdiagnosis). However, I'm realizing there's an architectural decision that is very much above my paygrade as a new contributor so I'd appreciate expert guidance! (I apologize in advance if this is poorly explained, I'm trying my best!) Based on the precedent of MonoidAlgebra (which has instances in Coalgebra/ -> Bialgebra/ -> HopfAlgebra/), I thought we'd want to have Coalgebra/SymmetricAlgebra.lean, Bialgebra/SymmetricAlgebra.lean, etc. But if you use Bialgebra.ofAlgHom in Bialgebra/SymmetricAlgebra.lean that creates what I understand to be a typeclass diamond (where the Bialgebra file would construct its own Coalgebra parent, right?) So either we need to skip the Coalgebra/SymmetricAlgebra.lean and let Bialgebra be the single source of truth about the Coalgebra instance (which seems bad because there's nothing under the Coalgebra/ path where people would expect to find it, and anybody who wants a Coalgebra would have to import Bialgebra/X.lean) or we need to let Coalgebra/ own the instance and directly construct Bialgebra.mk'. The latter seemed more consistent to me, but I don't know anything!

Robert Hawkins said:

constructs a second instance that unfolds differently which feels like it would create problems down the line.

Could you expand on this a bit for easier context, are you saying the instances are not definitionally equal? Or do you mean there are parts which unfold differently due to different exposed/unexposed definitions?

sorry, yes, I checked that they are definitionally equal but they unfold differently (or with different depth) -- one unfolds directly to comulAlgHom and the other has a deeper unfolds through letI, comul, etc. Is that not a problem? (maybe I am being too paranoid).

Keep in mind, diamonds currently do exist in Mathlib to some extent, consider the following:

import Mathlib

#synth Module ℤ ℤ
--@AddCommGroup.toIntModule Z Int.instAddCommGroup:Module ℤ ℤ
/- instance AddCommGroup.toIntModule (M : Type u_3)
[AddCommGroup M] : Module ℤ M
@[implicit_reducible, instance 910] instance Semiring.toModule
{R : Type u_1} [Semiring R] : Module R R -/
#check ((inferInstance : Semiring ℤ).toModule : Module ℤ ℤ)
--Semiring.toModule : Module ℤ ℤ

But more to your point, if they are definitionally equal you should likely not have issues, up to some nuance. As in, there should not be a need for a second instance necessarily to have this diamond.

We will see if the experts chime in!

i just keep reading threads where people are trying to remove them, or complaining about them, so I thought I would try to avoid this situation in my PR! i'm sorry if this isn't the right thing to be worried about.
No need to be sorry, I am including things for your educational purposes not to rag on you!
